cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 769, a flight from Wuhan to Amsterdam, you are parking at stand 221, you have received information Charlie, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 769，从武汉飞往阿姆斯特丹，停在 221 号停机位，已收到通播 Charlie，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES769, stand 221, information C, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES769，221 号停机位，通播 C，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1800 meters, Hotel Zulu 01 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，武汉放行，许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 1800 米，Hotel Zulu 01 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1800 meters, HZ 01 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 1800 米，HZ 01 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562，CES769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES769, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES769，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南，CES769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, taxi via Delta, Delta 4, hold short of runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，经 Delta、Delta 4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via D, D4, hold short of runway 36, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 D、D4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待，CES769。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, a passenger opened an emergency exit, inform the controller of this situation and airport security is needed to remove the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，一名旅客打开了应急出口，通知管制员该情况并需要机场安保带走该旅客。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES769, a passenger opened an emergency exit, request airport security to remove the passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES769，一名旅客打开了应急出口，请求机场安保带走该旅客。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2100 meters, Hotel Zulu 02 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，起始爬升 2100 米，Hotel Zulu 02 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: Recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2100 meters, HZ 02 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, the rest unchanged, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，起始爬升 2100 米，HZ 02 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，其余不变，CES769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point Whiskey 2 runway 36, contact Wuhan Tower and ask the permission to cross runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 Whiskey 2 等待点等待，联系武汉塔台并请求穿越跑道 36。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES769, holding point W2 runway36, request cross runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES769，跑道 36 W2 等待点，请求穿越跑道 36。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, expedite cross runway 36, when vacated, taxi the taxiway Zulu 5, Alpha 4 and Alpha, hold short of runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，快速穿越跑道 36，脱离后，经滑行道 Zulu 5、Alpha 4 和 Alpha 滑行，跑道 04 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Expedite cross runway 36, when vacated, taxi the taxiway Z5, A4 and A, hold short of runway 04, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 快速穿越跑道 36，脱离后，经滑行道 Z5、A4 和 A 滑行，跑道 04 外等待，CES769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of runway 04, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES769, holding short of runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES769，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, line up runway 04.
C: China Eastern 769, cleared for takeoff runway 04, surface wind 020, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 020，2 米/秒。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 11000 meters, over Whiskey X-Ray India, squawking 3562, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 11000 米，在 Whiskey X-Ray India 上空，应答机 3562，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES769, maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, squawking 3562.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CES769，保持 11000 米，WXI 上空，应答机 3562。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 769, increase speed to Mach 0.83 or greater, fly direct to Papa Echo Kilo.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 769，增速至马赫 0.83 或更大，直飞 Papa Echo Kilo。
cards.referenceText: Increase speed to M.83 or greater, fly direct to PEK, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 增速至 M.83 或更大，直飞 PEK，CES769。
